model.trained_on: Bangladesh: RiceLeafDiseaseBD v3 (Gazipur), BD5 (Savar), KYAU/raihan (Sirajganj-Pabna), Dhan-Shomadhan; India: Paddy Doctor, Sethy; Taiwan. Plus non-rice photos.

external.name: DIU Rice Leaf Disease and Pest Dataset, Bangladesh (half B, never used for training or tuning)
external.method: 2 Nov 2026, read once: app preprocessing (EXIF upright, Resize 366 + CenterCrop 320) and the app's full decision rule. Close-ups of single leaves on white. Classes outside the app's six count as 'other rice problem'. See model/experiments/run8_v8/FINAL_RESULT.md.

external.name: Rice Leaf Disease Classification BD (Aman 2025, Hugging Face Project-AgML), 422 photos with no copy in other datasets
external.method: 2 Nov 2026, read once: only images with no pHash match within 8 bits in any other dataset (351 of 773 are copies). Same app preprocessing and rule. See model/experiments/run7_v7/PROTOCOL_AMENDMENT_1.md.

limitations: No independent test covers sheath blight or leaf smut. Leaf smut is never named by the app (one field source only).
Tungro is often missed on new photos: recall 29% on the DIU test.
Rice problems the app does not cover are rejected only about half the time on the DIU test (55%, 'unseen rejection' above).
The DIU test is close-ups of single leaves on white; the Aman test is 422 field photos. Neither proves accuracy on every district, season or phone.

Version 8 was released by the project owner's decision after one release rule was revised post hoc: it beat the previous model on both independent tests, but on the Aman test it answers fewer photos (50.5% vs 54.5%), which the original rule required to be at least equal.
Disease text is preliminary and has not been reviewed by an agronomist.
